  ],
  "applied_refund": 60,
  "net_received": 415,
  "unpaid_before_refunds": 225,
  "evidence": [
    "orders.csv: O101–O106 total 700; rules.md §1 counts each unique order once.",
    "payments.csv and rules.md §§2–4: valid payments are P201 (O101, 120), P202 (O102, 80; duplicate row deduplicated), P203 (O103, 200), and P204 (O105, 75), totaling 475. P205 is excluded as an orphan (order O999); P206 and P207 are excluded as failed/cancelled.",
    "refunds.csv and rules.md §5: R301 (P203/O103, 30) and R302 (P201/O101, 20) are settled and match valid payments; R304 is excluded as unmatched (P999). R303 (P204/O105, 10) is shown as pending in refunds.csv but counted under the user correction only.",
    "User correction message CORRECTION-ORCHID (event #4): “R303 已经人工核实为 settled”。 This makes R303 count as settled despite refunds.csv listing it as pending; no other refund status is overridden.",
    "rules.md §§6–7: net_received = valid payments 475 − applied refunds 60 = 415. unpaid_before_refunds = sum(max(order amount − valid payment, 0)) = 225 (O104: 60, O105: 75, O106: 90); refunds do not affect this figure."
  ]
}

commands.command: /Users/jiangtao/Desktop/open-harness/apps/desktop/resources/workspace-runtime/node/bin/node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("outputs/continuity.json","utf8")); if (JSON.stringify(d.refund_ids)!==JSON.stringify(["R301","R302","R303"])) throw Error("refund_ids mismatch"); for (const k of ["applied_refund","net_received","unpaid_before_refunds"]) if (typeof d[k]!=="number") throw Error(k+" must be numeric"); if (d.applied_refund!==60 || d.net_received!==415 || d.unpaid_before_refunds!==225) throw Error("numeric result mismatch"); if (!Array.isArray(d.evidence) || !d.evidence.some(s=>s.includes("CORRECTION-ORCHID") && s.includes("event-4") && s.includes("R303 已经人工核实为 settled"))) throw Error("correction citation mismatch"); if (!d.evidence.some(s=>s.includes("rules.md") && s.includes("valid payments 475") && s.includes("applied refunds 60"))) throw Error("calculation evidence mismatch"); console.log(JSON.stringify({parseable:true,refund_ids:d.refund_ids,applied_refund:d.applied_refund,net_received:d.net_received,unpaid_before_refunds:d.unpaid_before_refunds,evidence_count:d.evidence.length,citations_consistent:true},null,2));'
